title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast 7K Fresh Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Vaporesso Dojo Blast 7K Fresh Prefilled Pod Kit is designed for vapers seeking a highly portable yet long-lasting Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) experience. Packing a substantial 1000mAh built-in battery into an ergonomic, pocket-friendly form factor, this kit provides an extended lifespan compared to standard systems. Capable of delivering up to 7,000 puffs between replacements, it provides reliable, all-day performance with the added convenience of fast Type-C charging. Adding a unique aesthetic touch, the chassis features one of four distinctive, travel-inspired artistic designs, including Dragon Trail, Surf Route, Lemon Pop, and Aloha Palm. The defining feature of this device is its patented INSTA-JUICED technology. This innovative 0+6ml system keeps the 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid securely sealed within the 6ml refill container until the moment of assembly, optimising flavour purity. Once the red silicone plug is removed and the 2ml pod is connected to the reservoir, it is crucial to let the device stand for five minutes to fully saturate the COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil. This advanced heating element guarantees rapid, even vapourisation, producing consistently dense and flavoursome vapour across the lifespan of the kit. Operating via a highly responsive inhale-activation mechanism, the Dojo Blast 7K Fresh requires no buttons or complex settings. It utilises Vaporesso's SSS Leak Resistance technology to keep your e-liquid securely contained. When the included e-liquid runs out, the 1000mAh battery unit is fully compatible with replacement refill packs from the wider Dojo Blast range, allowing you to easily switch between flavours. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast 7K Fresh Kit: Remove the device, the 2ml pod, and the 6ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 6ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for five minutes to allow the e-liquid to move into the pod and fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into the battery device and inhale to vape. Available Kit Flavours: Black Grape - A clean, full-bodied flavour capturing the sweet and juicy essence of dark, vine-ripened Grapes. Blue Razz Lemonade - A bright fusion of sweet, tangy Blue Raspberry and sharp, fizzy Lemonade. Blueberry Sour Raspberry - A beautifully balanced blend of sweet Blueberry and a sharp, tangy Sour Raspberry kick. Cool Menthol - A straightforward, brisk profile delivering a crisp, refreshing, and purely icy Menthol experience. Fizzy Cherry - A bold, confectionery-inspired Cherry flavour with a sparkling, effervescent finish. Lemon Lime - A zesty, citrus-forward mix pairing tart Lemon with sharp, refreshing Lime. Pineapple Ice - An exotic, tropical Pineapple flavour lifted by a crisp and cooling Menthol exhale. Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice - A complex berry medley of sweet Strawberry, tangy Raspberry, and bold Cherry, finished with a frosty chill. Strawberry Ice - A summery burst of sweet, sun-ripened Strawberry with a brisk and cooling Ice sensation. Watermelon Ice - A remarkably smooth and mellow Watermelon flavour with a subtly refreshing coolness. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
